source_en: Officer. Why are you standing at my fire? The booth is that way.
What are you doing out here?
Thinking. Something you should be doing in the booth, where you are paid to do it.
The only trouble here is an officer who wandered away from his post. Go and fix that.
Check in at the window. People are waiting, and you are out here warming your hands. Go. Back to work.
You again? There is a line at that window, Officer. Why are you not behind it?
I was calm. Then you walked over. Back to the booth.
Yes. Where the booth is. Watch the yard on your way back, something has been through here that was not human. Now go.
You are telling me? You are the one strolling the yard on the clock. Get back to work. Now.
